name: LAS-CAFIISICA — R20.5 OBJECT VETO + MDT PREVIEW

checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: Local Build Manager V0.1.11+ está incluído no repositório e pode ser iniciado por START_BUILD_MANAGER.bat.

checks.name: Git (opcional para ZIP)
checks.command: if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { git --version; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output 'Git não instalado — OK para pasta extraída do ZIP. Git Pull ficará indisponível.'; exit 0
checks.hint: Git só é necessário para Git Pull/clone. TEST e BUILD funcionam numa pasta ZIP válida.

test.name: Verificar fonte Ground Engine V2
test.command: $expected='LAS_CAFIISICA_GROUND_V2_2026_10_R20_5'; $p=Join-Path '%REPO%' 'localbuild/SOURCE_REVISION.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { throw ('SOURCE_REVISION em falta: ' + $p) }; $actual=(Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw ('Fonte errada. Esperado ' + $expected + ', encontrado ' + $actual) }; Write-Output ('OK SOURCE: ' + $actual)

test.name: Instalar dependencias de teste
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

test.name: Testar R20.5 veto + MDT preview
test.command: $env:QT_QPA_PLATFORM='offscreen'; & '%PYTHON%' -m pytest -q tests/test_r20_5_elevated_guard.py tests/test_r20_5_mdt_preview.py tests/test_r20_5_build_contract.py tests/test_r20_5_localbuild_source_guard.py tests/test_r20_4_universal_ground.py tests/test_viewer_camera_state.py

build.name: Verificar fonte Ground Engine V2
build.command: $expected='LAS_CAFIISICA_GROUND_V2_2026_10_R20_5'; $p=Join-Path '%REPO%' 'localbuild/SOURCE_REVISION.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { throw ('SOURCE_REVISION em falta: ' + $p) }; $actual=(Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw ('Fonte errada. Esperado ' + $expected + ', encontrado ' + $actual) }; Write-Output ('OK SOURCE: ' + $actual)

build.name: Instalar dependencias de build
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

build.name: Verificar LAS_CAFIISICA.exe
build.command: $exe=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA\dist\LAS_CAFIISICA\LAS_CAFIISICA.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $exe)) { throw ('LAS_CAFIISICA.exe nao foi gerado: ' + $exe) }; Get-Item $exe | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test do executavel
build.command: $dist=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA\dist\LAS_CAFIISICA'; Push-Location $dist; try { Remove-Item LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./LAS_CAFIISICA.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test nao criou relatorio' }; Get-Content ./LAS_CAFIISICA_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar pacote portatil
build.command: $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LBM\LASCAFIISICA'; $pkg=Join-Path $root 'package'; $dist=Join-Path $root 'dist\LAS_CAFIISICA'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg, '%LATEST%', '%ARCHIVE%' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse $dist (Join-Path $pkg 'LAS_CAFIISICA'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_LAS_CAFIISICA.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg
